scientific_integrity: A full analytic proof is provided. Exhaustive small cases, exact arithmetic and simulations supplement but do not replace the asymptotic proof. Historical priority remains open to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of independent homogeneous Bernoulli configurations, p_n tending to zero with n p_n diverging, binomial central-window thresholds; no rate or variable-event-count extension. This is the product-space testimony defect, not the diagonal BK gap.
title: A sparse Hall-polytope crossover for multiway disjoint threshold testimony
